WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_SKEWNESS = Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness (sample, bias-corrected) of lengths of qualifying WHITE diagonal segments (consecutive 0s/non-recurrent, length>=w_min=2) pooled over off-diagonal diagonals k!=0 with >=1 qualifying segment; fail-closed if <3 qualifying segment lengths, variance<=0/non-finite, or skewness non-finite/undefined. On trailing delay embedding (m=2,tau=1), L-inf recurrence eps=0.5*std(window). Causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if RTE/WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_SKEWNESS/ratio undefined/non-finite/degenerate or insufficient qualifying segments/gaps.

params.feature_compute_note: Causal trailing RQA computed every 2 bars and held (causal forward-hold) for runtime; signal/z/exec logic unchanged.
params.rte_definition: RTE = Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution p_w=n_w/sum_u n_u over qualifying gaps w>=w_min (w_min=2) excluding i==j; RTE=-sum_w p_w*ln(p_w); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying gap lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive
params.white_diag_line_length_skewness_definiti: WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_SKEWNESS = Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness (sample, bias-corrected) of lengths of qualifying WHITE diagonal segments (consecutive 0s/non-recurrent, length >= w_min=2) pooled over off-diagonal diagonals k!=0 with >=1 qualifying segment; fail-closed if <3 qualifying segment lengths, variance<=0/non-finite, or skewness non-finite/undefined.
params.white_segment_definition: white diagonal segment = run of consecutive 0-cells (non-recurrent) along an off-diagonal diagonal k!=0 of the RP; qualifying if length >= w_min
params.gap_definition: white vertical gap length w = number of consecutive 0-cells between successive recurrent points in a column (excluding trivial self at i==j); qualifying if w>=w_min
